name: shiftos-setup-coach
description: The ShiftOS Workspace guided setup interview. Say 'set up my ShiftOS' after installing your workspace: a five-phase interview (voice dump, 12-section answer-first interview, optional assessments, Working With Me synthesis) that writes ME/master-profile.md, starts your memory log, clears the first-run bootstrap, and verifies the result. Pause anytime and resume exactly where you left off.
